title: Full Appearance Studio Screen and State Specification
purpose: Implementation-grade UI/state specification derived from the completed PPIA-06 Appearance Studio control surface and CAPP registries.

progressive_disclosure.rule: Controls are generated from CAPP-01 eligibility and constraints; unavailable controls are omitted or explicitly disabled with reason, never replaced by humanoid defaults.

high_zoom.rule: preview collapses before mandatory semantic controls

keyboard_rules: Every category, choice, view, lock, randomize, preset, diagnostics, recovery, and commit action is reachable without pointer input.
Focus remains on the semantic control after preview regeneration.
Opening diagnostics or modal review traps focus until explicitly closed.
Escape cancels transient dialogs but never silently discards dirty draft state.

draft_lifecycle.edit: update draft then validate constraints then compile preview
draft_lifecycle.invalid_edit: preserve prior valid draft and expose explicit diagnostic
draft_lifecycle.randomize: CAPP-02 proposal applied to unlocked eligible draft fields only
draft_lifecycle.import: validate stable IDs and profile compatibility before applying to draft
draft_lifecycle.commit: explicit authorization creates one appearance mutation receipt
draft_lifecycle.ambiguous_commit_result: enter recovery state and verify receipt before retry
draft_lifecycle.successful_commit: replace baseline, clear dirty flag, preserve history receipt

error_empty_partial_states.behavior: keep Character editable; show nonvisual summary and unsupported coverage diagnostics
show available projection plus explicit missing coverage; never silently substitute
semantic editing remains available; preview uses explicit unknown/no-coverage state
no implicit humanoid controls; explain unavailable unresolved area
show unresolved stable IDs/incompatibilities before any commit
filtered before preview, summaries, diagnostics, and export
mark stale and regenerate from current authorized inputs before export

special_profile_rules.Arborae: four linked separately customizable seasonal profiles; current season remains upstream read-only
special_profile_rules.Mythragara: hybrid preview derives from authored base and authorized animal identities
special_profile_rules.Nekron: appearance cannot trigger or choose unavailable ascension
special_profile_rules.Suula: persistent adaptation markers read-only; live hand/claw state remains pose/upstream
special_profile_rules.Furashin: preferred authored phenotype separate from mechanics-controlled live phenotype
special_profile_rules.ManyToms: constituent identity repeats coherently; no exact visible constituent count requirement
special_profile_rules.Stygian: horn/wing visibility does not grant mechanics
special_profile_rules.Toba-Madra: natural fur and cosmetic dye are distinct; actual cybernetics projected only
special_profile_rules.The Free: broad humanoid android grammar without arbitrary nonhumanoid topology invention
special_profile_rules.Vespin: four-arm topology required or renderer reports unsupported
special_profile_rules.Moravi: two arms plus four legs preserved
special_profile_rules.Rakuuta: required facial feather field preserved; swept-back structures treated as ears
